instructions_to_main_agent: Use French language consistently across all views (Homepage, Boutique, Fiche Produit, Panier, Checkout, Confirmation, Blog, À propos, Admin).
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-1', data-testid='checkout-submit-btn').
Apply CSS variables in index.css so colors can be tweaked globally.
First product is 'Budget mensuel Excel' priced at 7,99 € with features like instant download, automated charts, dual device support, and multi-currency support.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on header or dropdown overlays.
Keep buttons legible with solid background colors and warm rounded corners (rounded-xl).

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for body text against backgrounds. Focus states must have distinct outline ring.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.testing: All key user action buttons and form inputs must have role-based data-testid attributes.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.responsive: Mobile-first approach with fluid grid and clean drawer navigation for screens below 768px.
